1.why: The visible text uses a clean, legible sans-serif typeface, but with only a heading and a single status line on screen, generous letter and line spacing is never actually demonstrated.

2.why: The only text shown ('Local Bank', 'Loading secure setup…', 'Logs') contains no italics, no all-caps, and no dense blocks of text.

3.why: The narrow centred column with ample white space is readable and uncluttered at mobile width, although there is almost no content to judge.

4.why: The sole guidance is the terse status line 'Loading secure setup…'; no actual enrolment instructions are ever provided.

5.why: No input fields and no example of expected input appear anywhere on the screen.

6.why: The screen contains only one short line of text, so the user is never required to read a long block of text to proceed (the flow simply never advances past loading).

7.why: No codes or secrets are ever displayed and no copy-to-clipboard mechanism exists.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry is offered on the screen.

9.why: There are no form fields at all, so browser autofill and password-manager support is neither present nor demonstrable.

10.why: No step indicator and no primary action button are shown, only a loading status banner and an empty 'Logs' card.

11.why: The screen requests zero actions, so it fails to present one clear main action rather than satisfying the statement.

12.why: The banner states what is happening ('Loading secure setup…') but nothing confirms a completed action or states what comes next.

13.why: No controls exist to retry a step, reveal or hide codes, or re-request codes.

14.why: No error messages are shown anywhere, so problem-and-fix messaging is not demonstrated.

15.why: No time limit is visible, but there is also no code-entry step at all, so generous time to enter codes is not actually provided.
